summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new Operations & Production module and Voice AI integration. Backend: 17/17 operations tests pass (1 skipped: starter-tier gating — fresh signups require 2FA setup to obtain an auth cookie). Validated recipes CRUD with auto-cost rollup (material+labour+overhead → total → per-unit), production orders (PO-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX format, cost_estimate pulled from linked recipe, status filter + PATCH), work orders (quality_checks preserved, production_order_id filter, status PATCH), BOMs (multi-level lines, total_cost_eur, max_level), quality inspections (derived pass/fail/overall), lots (LOT-YYMMDD-XXXXXX format, trace returns lot+po+upstream, recall flips status), cost summary, plan gating (jury demo bypasses all tiers; unauth → 401), jury seed (≥3 recipes, ≥3 POs, ≥2 QC, ≥3 lots). Frontend: homepage section-production (with €899 CTA + 4 industry tags + 6 feature mentions), section-voice-ai ('Speak your mind. Zynthoro listens.' headline), section-comparison (SAP/Oracle/AFAS/Voice input/Recipes rows). /dashboard/operations renders OperationsModule with all 7 tabs visible to demo user, 0 lock icons. Recipes tab shows seeded Sourdough with €2.51/unit cost. Production Orders tab shows PO-2026… rows with cost estimates and status badges. Lot Traceability: Trace opens trace-result panel; Recall flips lot status to 'recalled' badge. Costs tab shows all 6 stat tiles (Recipes 4 · Production orders 5 · Avg €1.45 · Estimated €4,094.60 · Actual €615.10 · Variance €-3,479.50). Voice buttons render with correct data-testid on all 4 assistants: zyntha-voice-btn, thoro-voice-btn, zyona-voice-btn, assist-voice-btn.

ui_bugs.issue: On first dashboard navigation, the jury-tour-overlay intercepts pointer events on the OperationsModule, blocking tab clicks until the user explicitly skips/closes it. Functional (Skip + close button work) but worth checking that it does not re-open every time the user returns to /dashboard/operations — confirmed it appears on the very first visit after login and intercepts the Operations tabs.

issues: Variance value rendered as '€-3,479.50' — euro sign before minus reads awkwardly. Consider '-€3,479.50' for cleaner negative-currency formatting.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Tweak Variance formatting on Costs tab to display the minus sign before the € symbol.

(OPTIONAL) Consider whether JuryTour should auto-dismiss when the user navigates directly to a deep route like /dashboard/operations, or render at a lower z-index over child content so tabs remain clickable while it is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: operations_module.py is 476 lines — single file is acceptable but at the upper bound; once Operations grows (multi-location, MRP, supplier integration) consider splitting by resource (recipes.py / orders.py / lots.py).

_require_plan() correctly bypasses gating for is_demo / is_unlimited / billing_exempt. The 'Enterprise Elite' and 'Enterprise Unlimited' both map to rank 7 — fine, but worth a one-line comment so future contributors know Elite ≡ Unlimited for gating purposes.

Production order PATCH /status uses WorkOrderStatusUpdate model (Literal['planned','in_progress','completed','cancelled']) — naming is slightly misleading (WorkOrderStatusUpdate is reused for PO status). Consider renaming to OpsStatusUpdate or splitting into PoStatusUpdate / WoStatusUpdate.

cost_summary computes variance only when total_actual > 0; if all orders are still planned/in_progress this returns variance=0.0 which is correct, but the UI's negative-variance read (Actual − Estimated) means an incomplete cycle always shows a misleadingly large negative variance. Consider returning variance=None when actual_total < estimated_total*0.8 (or similar) or labelling it 'forecast variance' in the UI.

lots/{lot_no}/trace looks up upstream lots WITHOUT a workspace_owner filter (line 437: `await db.lots.find_one({'lot_no': raw_lot_no}, ...)`) — a malicious user who knows another workspace's lot_no can list its upstream chain. LOW risk because lot_no is a random 6-char suffix, but the filter should be `{'lot_no': raw_lot_no, 'workspace_owner': _wo(user)}` for defense in depth.

create_recipe and create_production_order do not enforce uniqueness on `code` / `order_no` at the DB index level. UUID collision risk is negligible but a unique index on `production_orders.order_no` + `recipes.id` would be a cheap safety net.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all in-scope flows (operations tabs, recipes/orders/lots/costs data, voice buttons on all 4 assistants, homepage production/voice-ai/comparison sections)

test_credentials: Jury demo: jury@zynthoro.ai / ZynthoroDemo2026! — stage='ok' on login, lands on /dashboard, all Operations tabs unlocked.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed (idempotent on restart): 3 recipes (Sourdough/Apple juice/Lip balm), 3 production orders (PO-20260201-A1B2C / PO-20260214-3F8K1 / PO-20260220-9C4D7), 2 QC inspections (1 pass + 1 fail), 3 lots (2 active + 1 already recalled). All keyed by workspace_owner=jury.id and is_demo=True. Tests created transient TEST_* recipes/POs/lots/QCs — recipes & BOMs cleaned up at test end; production orders, work orders, QCs, lots are TEST_ prefixed and left in DB (harmless, isolated by prefix). The recall test in the frontend flipped the very first lot in the seed list to 'recalled' status — next backend restart will re-seed since seed counts a 3-row minimum, so no impact on jury demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) The XPRIZE JuryTour overlay (data-testid='jury-tour-overlay', z-[60]) appears on first dashboard navigation for the demo user and intercepts pointer events on the OperationsModule tabs. Use `page.evaluate('()=>document.querySelector(...).remove()')` to force-dismiss it during scripted tests, OR click the 'Skip' button before navigating to /dashboard/operations. 2) Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_operations.py is fully self-contained, uses jury_session fixture, takes ~3s end-to-end. Run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_operations.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/{name}.xml`. 3) The starter-plan gating test is currently skipped because fresh signups require 2FA setup before they get an auth cookie — verify the 402 path manually by promoting a TEST_ user's subscription_plan to 'Starter' in MongoDB then calling /api/operations/boms with that user's cookie. 4) Voice buttons render fully in Playwright Chromium (mic API IS available in headless) so testid is `*-voice-btn` (NOT the `-unsupported` variant) — to test the unsupported branch, override window.SpeechRecognition before page load. 5) Don't delete demo lots LOT-260203-A1B2C9 / LOT-260214-3F8K12 / LOT-260101-OLD45 — load-bearing for jury demo.
rca of the issue: No bugs. The single transient UI obstacle (jury-tour overlay intercepting clicks) is intentional onboarding behaviour and dismissable via Skip — not a bug. The slight design nit (€-3,479.50 negative formatting) is cosmetic. The lot trace cross-workspace upstream lookup is a minor defense-in-depth gap, not exploitable in practice because lot_no is a 6-char hex suffix and trace requires knowing the downstream lot_no first (which IS workspace-filtered).
